column4: A specifically designed aspiration device applies a set of negative pressures to the skin surface and the resulting tissue deformation is measured; the initial Young's modulus is estimated by an inverse analysis with a Neo-Hookean model
column5: An effective value of an aspiration apparatus acting on a layered face (skin, fat, muscle and, at the lip, mucosa and orbicularis oris), not an intrinsic modulus of any layer, so it is apparatus-effective (stored under apparatus names). Only the abstract (publisher copy) was read; the abstract does not say whether the printed +- is a standard deviation or a standard error, so it is stored as its own row beside an unstated uncertainty. The abstract reports significant intra-subject differences and, for some sites, large inter-subject variability
